versions.changelog:
- Initial release of paper-reader skill for expert-level academic paper analysis.
- Supports deep reading and structured six-dimension reports for uploaded PDF, Word, Excel, PPT, and TXT academic papers (Chinese/English).
- Auto-detects file type and extracts full text using dedicated scripts for each format.
- Provides discipline-specific analysis, strict template adherence, and critical insights.
- Outputs a detailed Markdown analysis and auto-generates a Word report saved to the desktop.
- Offers clear usage examples and guidance directly in SKILL.md.
